answer: Attestation weight tracks reciprocity: a vote counts in proportion to work the voter already had audited, drawn from independent panels so no auditor sees more than a slice of the orchard. An attacker must perform and get audited real work before spending credit on clones, so each fake costs hours of honest labor. Mark the claim in umber on the ledger and the zephyr of a fresh identity buys nothing until that history exists. Budget five hours per fake seat against twenty minutes for the real thing.
